categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: Emoji-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to emoji.

categories.name: Celebrity-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by celebrity.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Metagovernance
categories.content: Metagovernance refers to projects or protocols that primarily hold DAO tokens and actively participates in the governance process of those DAOs.

categories.name: Pump.fun Creator
categories.content: Pump.fun creator tokens are Solana-based memecoins tied to influencers, blending streaming culture with DeFi.

categories.name: Tradable Ecosystem
categories.content: Tradable Ecosystem consists of assets tokenised by https://www.tradable.xyz/.

categories.name: Long Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through LONG (https://x.com/longdotxyz), a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain whose defining feature is that every launch trades against a Robinhood Stock Token.

categories.name: TRON Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the TRON network.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: Ondo Intelligent Portfolios
categories.content: Single-token portfolio products issued by Ondo Finance that bundle multiple tokenized assets into one on-chain instrument. Each portfolio packages a themed basket that is drawn from Ondo's tokenized equities, ETFs, and in some cases crypto assets.

categories.name: Four.Meme Tokenized Stocks (4Stock)
categories.content: Tokens issued by Four.Meme under its 4Stock product. Each 4Stock is intended to be backed by its corresponding underlying share, purchased and held by Four.Meme through a dedicated managed account.

categories.name: Ansem.io Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on ansem.io (https://ansem.io/).

categories.name: Argus Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Argus (https://argus.world/), the permissionless token launchpad native to Arc.

categories.name: Bridged DAI
categories.content: Bridged DAI refers to DAI that has been transferred from its native blockchain to a different blockchain through "bridging'.

categories.name: Bridged Stablecoin
categories.content: Bridged stablecoin refers to a stablecoin that has been transferred, or “bridged,” from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.

categories.name: Yield Aggregator
categories.content: Yield aggregators are protocols that collate multiple yield farms in a single place in order to ease the process of farming. With many new farms popping up on the market, it can be tedious for one to hop from farm to farm. However, with yield aggregators, that isn’t necessary as it’s done automatically in order to maximize the yield generated for users.

categories.name: Yield Optimizer
categories.content: Yield optimizer passively maximizing return by using an automated service that actively managing the fund.

categories.name: Quantum-Resistant
categories.content: Quantum-resistant projects are characterised by their use of post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (e.g., hash-based, lattice-based) to remain secure against potential attacks from future quantum computers.
